Each one got a new still (free), checked by eye before any video was made, then one new clip with the same motion as before. 35 of the 37 are in this cut, on the same beats as cut 4.
Better, small fault left (8): a02-a, a03-b, g11, k09, k12, k13, v07, x03.
Same fault came back (9): d06, f03, k22, k27, v03, v11, x07, k02, k19. The still was right, but the triangle slides to the middle as the clip moves, or is lost on the crimson mask.
Worse, old clip kept (2): d02 (grew goggles), k31 (round red eyes).
The 9 above plus d02 and k31 still break the mask rule. A second re-roll costs credits and may drift the same way; your call.
